font dir "fonts"
font body "Source Serif Pro"
section 1 number "1"
  text "Text Inside Math"
para
  text "A text-style command resolves to the alphabet it means, so "
  formula inline "\\textbf {u}"
    ord:alpha:bf{ord:𝑢}
  text " is the upright bold letter and "
  formula inline "\\textit {v}"
    ord:alpha:it{ord:𝑣}
  text " the italic one, exactly as "
  formula inline "\\mathbf {u}"
    ord:alpha:bf{ord:𝑢}
  text " and "
  formula inline "\\mathit {v}"
    ord:alpha:it{ord:𝑣}
  text " set them. A colour travels with its subformula, so "
  formula inline "\\textcolor {blue}{w}"
    ord:{ink:#0000FF ord:𝑤}
  text " renders its letter in blue. A word stands upright inside a formula: "
  formula inline "\\text {gain} + \\text {loss}"
    ord:"gain" bin:+ ord:"loss"
  text ", a brace group inside one is grouping alone in "
  formula inline "\\text {a{b}c}"
    ord:"abc"
  text ", and a symbol inside one contributes its scalar in "
  formula inline "\\text {first\\ldots  last}"
    ord:"first…last"
  text "."
para
  text "An alignment carries all of it at once:"
role display-veao
  center
    para
      formula display "\\textcolor {blue}{\\textbf {\\sum _k}} a_k &= b \\\\ &= \\text {\\textbf {bound} above}"
        ord:align[(|ord:{ink:#0000FF ord:alpha:bf{op:lim:∑_{ord:𝑘}}} ord:𝑎_{ord:𝑘}|ord:{} rel:= ord:𝑏)(||ord:{} rel:= ord:"bound above")]
para
  text "An alignment’s reasons are words, each kept on one line however narrow the column:"
role display-veao
  center
    para
      formula display "a + b &= b + a && \\text {by the placeholder rule that swaps two terms} \\\\ &= c && \\text {by an invented lemma}"
        ord:align[(|ord:𝑎 bin:+ ord:𝑏|ord:{} rel:= ord:𝑏 bin:+ ord:𝑎||ord:{} ord:"by the placeholder rule that swaps two terms")(||ord:{} rel:= ord:𝑐||ord:{} ord:"by an invented lemma")]
para
  text "A run keeps the spaces it writes, as in a condition:"
role display-pefo
  center
    para
      formula display "f(x) = 1 \\quad \\text {if} x > 0, \\qquad f(x) = 0 \\quad \\text {otherwise}"
        ord:𝑓 open:( ord:𝑥 close:) rel:= ord:1 mu:18 ord:"if " ord:𝑥 rel:> ord:0 punct:, mu:36 ord:𝑓 open:( ord:𝑥 close:) rel:= ord:0 mu:18 ord:"otherwise"
para
  text "What the engine still does not model degrades to content: "
  math inline "\\overset {?}{=}"
  text " sets its characters and names the construct, and no control sequence reaches the page."
